idea-plugin.name: Find duplicates inspection
idea-plugin.description:
(Experimental) Finds Java classes with the same fully qualified name in the project classpath. For each duplicate, the plugin provides a diff quick-fix and, when the local file is writable, a quick-fix to remove it.
Requires IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition 2024.3 or later.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.0:
  • Modernized inspection registration using the IntelliJ Platform local inspection API.
  • Removed deprecated inspection category and writable-file API usage.
  • Added characterization tests for duplicate detection and quick-fixes.
  • Added IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition 2024.3 compatibility verification.
  • Raised the minimum supported platform build to 243.
Previous: 1.2.1: Fixed compatibility warnings from the Plugin Portal. 1.2: Some renames. 1.1: Initial release.
